project: New Super Mario Bros. Wii native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Boots, creates its save, plays the opening cutscene and the world map, and enters level 1-1 with the sideways Wii Remote layout. 60 fps on both machines. All four of the game's code modules run as native code. Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
